reasons.text: The label photo on this claim is identical (same sha256) to the label photo on another claim in the program, so the claim is flagged for review as a possible duplicate.
The label is legible and shows model 9421, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The retailer Graybar Electric Co. is on the sold-at list and the purchase date 2024-01-19 falls inside the sale window, so the purchase is valid and no receipt is required.
The serial check was skipped by the tool, so the serial was not verified against the recalled ranges; this is noted for the reviewer.
